plt.title("Number of Arrests by Borough")
plt.xticks(rotation=30)
plt.show()

The analysis shows that Brooklyn (K) has more arrests than the Bronx (B) in this dataset; however, this does not necessarily mean more crime occurs there. Arrest data reflects policing practices as well as actual incidents, which can introduce bias. Factors such as over-policing in certain communities or differences in enforcement priorities can influence the results. Therefore, conclusions should be interpreted cautiously and not assumed to represent true crime rates.
